title: Hollywood Meets Miami Beach Movie and Tasting Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Learn, laugh and enjoy on this interactive street food tasting and learning experience about movie history of South Beach. Indulge in the Art Deco architecture which served as set for Hollywood blockbusters and experience vibrant culture in this Miami neighborhood during our movie and food walking tour. Walk along Flamingo park neighborhood, Ocean Drive, Lummus park and Espanola Way and check out the Art Deco movie shooting locations, hotels, restaurants and nightclubs along the way. Taste some local street snacks and end your tour on the ocean breeze terrace in Miami Vice style - with a cocktail.
